summary: Full E2E testing of new Bantuin (custom help request) feature. All 6 backend endpoints pass (8/8 pytest cases). Frontend E2E mobile flow validated: landing → suggestion click → form submit → 3 auto-generated offers → select helper → status progression (helper_selected → on_the_way → in_progress → completed) → success card. BottomNav floating Bantuin center button working with green gradient + Sparkles icon. Desktop view also loads correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: BantuinDetailPage.js (~319 lines) — approaching the 700-line limit but acceptable; consider extracting OfferCard, StatusTracker, SelectedHelperCard if it grows further.

select-helper endpoint does not guard against re-selection: a request already in 'helper_selected' or further can have its selected_helper_id overwritten. Consider returning 400 if status != 'searching'.

/api/bantuin/{id}/status accepts ANY string for status (no enum validation). Suggest using a StrEnum (searching/helper_selected/on_the_way/in_progress/completed/cancelled) in BantuinStatusUpdate to reject invalid values.
Mock photo upload uses a hardcoded Unsplash URL toggle; real upload not implemented (acceptable per MVP scope, but should be flagged as MOCKED for users).
generate_helper_offers uses random.sample(MOCK_HELPERS, 3); fine with 5 helpers but will throw if count > pool. Guard with min(count, len(MOCK_HELPERS)).
No DELETE endpoint for bantuin requests; users can't cancel a request even though 'cancelled' is a valid status in the schema.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (17/17 critical flow steps; step 16 escrow check was test-side: notice is intentionally hidden on completed status)

test_credentials: None required (no auth in this app)
seed_data_creation: 5 BantuinRequest documents (with TEST_ prefix titles) and 15 helper offers created in MongoDB during testing. Safe to leave or clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bantuin feature is fully functional E2E. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_bantuin_api.py. The escrow notice (`🛡️ Pembayaran Aman`) is intentionally hidden when status='completed' — that is correct behavior, success card replaces it. Floating center Bantuin button uses green gradient (from-green-700 to-emerald-600) with -mt-6 to raise above nav line and ring-4 highlight when active. BottomNav has lg:hidden class so it's only visible on mobile/tab viewports. Auto-generated helper offers select 3 of 5 mock helpers; prices use random.uniform(0.85, 1.1) of budget rounded to nearest 1000 — test allows 83-112% tolerance to absorb rounding.
verified_flows: POST /api/bantuin returns BTN-XXXXXX format and auto-creates 3 offers
PUT /api/bantuin/{id}/status flow: helper_selected → on_the_way → in_progress → completed (with completed_at timestamp)
404 on nonexistent request and nonexistent offer
BottomNav: 5 items (Beranda, Pesanan, [Bantuin floating], Chat, Akun) all present with data-testids
/bantuin landing: hero card, query input, 8 suggestions, How-it-works 4 steps
/bantuin/new: form (title prefilled from suggestion), detail, location, schedule (4 opts), budget (6 opts + custom), photo toggle, submit
/bantuin/request/{id}: offers list → select → status tracker with 4 visible steps → demo advance buttons → completed success card
/bantuin/my-requests: list with status badges and request_number
